item.title: FDA Launches New Program to Advance Neuroscience Medical Product Development
item.description: FDA announces the launch of the Neuroscience Advancement and Innovation Nexus (NAIN), a new agency program aligned with the Trump Administration’s efforts to accelerate medical innovation and deliver breakthrough treatments.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: FDA Approves First-of-Its-Kind Chronic Hepatitis B Treatment
item.description: FDA today approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection, in combination with existing antiviral therapy, to treat chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in certain adults without cirrhosis.
item.dc:creator: FDA
